- A notarized vendor attestation (signed by our CFO) describing our entity details and tax residency (I have a draft attached)
- A short, recorded video where the authorized signatory (CFO) shows their passport and states their name and title verbally (we can timestamp and notarize the recording if that helps)

I've attached a passport scan and our proposed attestation template for your review. We can also route the attestation via DocuSign (I will include a link in a follow-up).

Is there a way to use the video + notarized attestation as an alternative so the PO can be issued on a conditional basis? If you need a short sample video spec (format, length, wording), I can provide it.

Appreciate your help — we have an urgent invoice timing constraint and would like the PO by the end of next week if possible.

Best,

Hi all,

Quick finance input — we can accept a bank-letter alternative for non-US entities in constrained cases, provided controls are met. Required package for conditional PO issuance:
- Notarized attestation (on company letterhead) signed by an authorized officer (CFO/CEO) — must include EIN/TIN or a statement explaining absence of local TIN and the claimed tax residency.
- Video passport verification: must be a continuous clip (no edits), show the signer stating: full name, title, company name, country of tax residency, and today's date. Recommended length 30–60s; MP4 preferred.
- Redacted bank statement (last 3 months) showing account name and last 4 digits — acceptable if other details are obscured.
- Completed W-8BEN-E (if non-US) with signatory details; if you have a GIIN please include it.

If the package above is provided and matches onboarding records, procurement may approve a conditional PO with the following caveats:
- Conditional PO valid for 30 days; failure to provide a full bank-letter or required tax cert will freeze future POs and payments.
- Payment hold may be applied if any discrepancy arises during review.

Marta — please send the notarized attestation and the MP4 via DocuSign or secure link. Once we receive those, Procurement (Laura) will create the conditional PO and Finance will clear payment upon invoice review.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
